detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: This article does not describe malware or malicious code. It explains a vulnerability prioritization feature (Reachable Vulnerabilities) in Snyk, which analyzes call graphs to determine if vulnerable functions in dependencies are actually reachable from application code. No detection strategy for malware is applicable, as there are no indicators of compromise or malicious behaviors described.
